Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿 Happy to help with this one.

Every live plant comes with a Plant Care Guarantee that lasts:

- **30 days** from the delivery date for all customers
- **90 days** from delivery for Leafy Plus members, on plants ordered while their membership is active

If your plant dies or declines significantly despite reasonable care, we'll send **one** free replacement of the same plant (or store credit if it's out of stock). To make a claim:

- Go to "My Orders" within the guarantee window
- Upload at least **two photos** (one of the whole plant and one close-up)
- A Plant Care Specialist will review your claim within **2 business days**, and you don't need to send the plant back

Also good to know: the replacement plant gets its own new 30-day guarantee, so it can be replaced once more if it fails.

If you'd like some free care tips for a plant you're worried about, our Plant Care Specialists are happy to help by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri) or email.

Please reach out anytime if you have more questions. Happy planting! 🌱
